submission.name: PlayByPlay Pal
submission.tagline: A spoken, plain-language guide to following campus soccer highlights.
submission.inspiration: We wanted friends who are new to soccer to enjoy campus match clips without needing to know every rule or player. A short, friendly spoken explanation seemed like a way to make highlights easier to follow together.
submission.what_it_does: The demo lets a user choose a soccer highlight clip and request a simple explanation of the play, then generates a spoken version with ElevenLabs. Clip selection and text generation work in separate parts, so the narration is not consistently timed to the video yet.
submission.how_we_built_it: A React frontend handles clip selection and playback, an Express server passes requests to a small Python transcript and explanation service, and ElevenLabs generates audio from the resulting text. Gemini through OpenRouter is used for the plain-language explanation, though the services are still stitched together manually in the demo.
submission.challenges_we_ran_into: Coordinating video, transcript, explanation, and audio responses across several services made timing difficult. Some clips have no usable transcript, and in those cases the explanation or narration can be missing or generic.
submission.accomplishments: We got a basic path from a selected clip to an AI explanation and generated voice working. We are proud of the direction for making sports clips more welcoming to newcomers, even though the full playback experience needs more integration.
submission.what_we_learned: We learned how much audio latency affects a feature that is meant to accompany video, and how useful ElevenLabs can be for turning short text into listenable narration. Gemini helped us test different explanation styles, but transcript quality remains important.
submission.whats_next: We would connect clip transcripts and audio playback more reliably, then add a few explanation styles for different experience levels. We would also make it easier to use clips with captions or transcripts already available.
